pages.text: The Circle believed the silence here was emptiness. It was not empty. It was $(l)listening$().$(br2)Vael, the Colossus, Morvane: each was something the Listener took and kept. Bring back a piece of each, and you can call the Listener itself.
pages.title: The Listener

pages.text: $(li)The $(l)Hollow Sovereign$() drops a $(l)Sovereign's Sigil$()$(li)The $(l)Amethyst Colossus$() drops a $(l)Colossus Heart$()$(li)$(l)Morvane$() drops $(l)Morvane's Oath$()$(br2)Bind the three with three $(l)Echo Shards$() to make the $(l)Seal of Unmaking$().
pages.title: Three Trophies

pages.name: Ritual of Unmaking
pages.text: Only in the Hollow, at Ascension, with 300 mana. Offer the Seal.

$(li)It flies, and hurls $(l)skulls$(). Below half strength, arrows will not touch it.$(li)It drags you into the dark.$(li)Wounded, it rains $(l)void$() from above (move when the air shimmers) and calls the echoes of its servants.$(li)At the end it $(l)drinks your mana$() and $(l)unmakes$(): a lance that corrupts.$(br2)$(l)Reflect$() is a fine answer to the skulls.
pages.title: The Fight

pages.text: Silence it, and the story ends.$(br2)You become an $(l)Archmage$(): the seventh stage, with 100 more mana and tier IV spells. Your corruption is washed away.$(br2)And the world will still be there afterward. So will your magic.
pages.title: After
